description: The plot on the right side of Figure 4 illustrates the relationship between the Accuracy@1 on geometry problems (Geomverse) and tree width for rol. The x-axis is labeled "Tree Width" and ranges from 0 to 40, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and ranges from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The line in the plot is blue, with a solid line style. The line starts at a value of approximately 19.4% at a tree width of 0 and increases to a peak of approximately 89.2% at a tree width of 40. The line then slightly declines to a value of approximately 83.9% at a tree width of 50. The plot does not provide any additional information or annotations.
